name: Manappuram Finance Ltd
about: Manappuram Finance is a Non-Banking Finance Company (NBFC), which provides a wide range of fund based and fee based services including gold loans, money exchange facilities, etc. The Company is a Systemically Important Non-Deposit taking NBFC(NBFC-ND).(Source : 202003 Annual Report Page No:120)

cash.note: For lenders, operating cash flow mostly reflects loan-book growth, so conversion ratios are not meaningful.

flags.text: Revenue compounded 8.5% a year over 5 years but profit shrank 10.5% a year: growth is getting less profitable
Share capital up 11% in three years: new shares from an issue, a merger or a bonus. Only the first two dilute
Gross NPA fell from 3.00% to 1.60% in a year: asset quality is improving

business.what: Manappuram Finance is an NBFC best known for gold loans, lending against pledged gold jewellery. It also runs microfinance (Asirvad), vehicle finance, MSME loans and home loans. It earns mainly interest income on these loans.

segments.name: Gold loans
segments.comment: Main growth engine; AUM up about 12% QoQ and yield up 59 bps.

segments.name: Microfinance (Asirvad)
segments.comment: AUM up 5.8% QoQ; PAT rose to INR21 crore from INR13 crore.

segments.name: Vehicle finance
segments.comment: AUM down 14.3% QoQ; GNPA elevated at 13.3%, focus on collections.

segments.name: MSME and allied loans
segments.comment: AUM INR3,303 crore; GNPA improved to 5.9% from 7.1%.

segments.name: Home loans
segments.comment: Book flat QoQ at INR1,847 crore, down about 3% YoY.

kpis.name: Gold loan customers
kpis.value: 26.5 lakh outstanding; about 3.2 lakh added in quarter

ledger.promise: Profit turns 'green' and non-gold losses fall further by Q4 FY26
ledger.quote: Q4 at least, I think we should see the financials as green
ledger.actual: Consolidated PAT rose from 239 (Q3 FY26) to 405 (Q4 FY26), up 69.5%. No subsidiary/segment P&L is given, so the non-gold loss trend itself can't be checked.

ledger.promise: Q1 FY27 profit similar to or slightly better than Q4 FY26 ('it is the bottom')
ledger.quote: But with that, I think it is the bottom. And this quarter, it will be similar or slightly better.
ledger.actual: Q1 FY27 PAT 585 vs 405 in Q4 FY26, up 44.4%; PBT 782 vs 564. Well above guidance.

ledger.promise: Gold loan AUM CAGR of 20-25% (25% can be maintained)
ledger.quote: we are targeting a CAGR of 20%-25%
ledger.actual: No AUM data. Proxies: FY26 borrowings 57,837 vs 36,077 (+60.3%), operating cash flow -20,238; Q1 FY27 revenue +34.1% YoY. Guidance raised to 25-30% in Q1 FY27.

ledger.promise: Better loan growth in Q3 and Q4 FY26
ledger.quote: we are expecting good growth, better growth in this quarter and coming quarter
ledger.actual: Loan data not given. Revenue rose from 2,273 (Q2) to 2,354 (Q3, +3.6%) to 2,614 (Q4 FY26, +11.0%).

ledger.promise: Standalone ROA of 4.25-4.5% in H2 FY27
ledger.quote: I would say, yes, we should definitely be looking at 4.25% to 4.5%.
ledger.actual: H2 FY27 hasn't arrived yet. The Q1 FY27 call gave a lower ROA target of 3.5-4%, without saying whether it is standalone or consolidated. No asset data to compute ROA.

ledger.promise: Consolidated ROE to settle at 13-16% within 1-2 years; over 15% by FY28
ledger.quote: So we expect to stabilize somewhere around 13% to 16% in the next 1 or 2 years' time.
ledger.actual: No equity data to compute ROE. The Q1 FY27 call raised the target to 15-18%, and about 18% within three years.

ledger.promise: Gold loan yield around 18.5%, later 18-18.15% by end-FY26
ledger.quote: We expect that to be somewhere around 18.5 similar to the industry
ledger.actual: The guide moved down in steps: about 18.5% (Q2 FY26), 18-18.15% (Q3), 17.5-18% (Q4), then about 18% ±25 bps (Q1 FY27). Actual yields aren't reported.

ledger.promise: Non-gold businesses (MSME, vehicle, housing) return to growth from Q1 FY27
ledger.quote: We hope to go back to a growth mode from quarter 1 FY '27 onwards
ledger.actual: Q1 FY27 call: no vehicle loan disbursements in FY27, restart to be reconsidered in FY28. Microfinance capped at 8-10% of consolidated AUM.

ledger.promise: Long-term strategy presented by around Q4 FY26
ledger.quote: the long-term strategy, I will present by around Quarter 4
ledger.actual: The Q3 FY26 call pushed it to Q1 FY27. The Q1 FY27 call then gave ROA 3.5-4%, ROE 15-18%, gold 25-30% growth and portfolio mix caps.

ledger.promise: Bain transaction approval within about one month
ledger.quote: we hope that will be through in another one month
ledger.actual: Still pending at the Q3 FY26 call (Feb 2026), which again said 'within another 1 month'. Later calls don't confirm closing or a capital infusion.

ledger.promise: Open 500-550 new gold loan branches in FY27
ledger.quote: So we plan to open some 500 to 550 branches in gold loan during this year.
ledger.actual: Q1 FY27 call: about 500 branches, now counting Manappuram and Asirvad together. Openings were slow in the first months, with improvement expected in Q2.

ledger.promise: Lower credit costs and moderating slippages in coming quarters
ledger.quote: as the quality of book is improving, we will see a reduced credit cost in the coming quarters.
ledger.actual: Provisions aren't disclosed. Consolidated PBT went 303 (Q3 FY26), 564 (Q4), 782 (Q1 FY27), which fits but doesn't prove lower credit cost.

current_guidance.quote: We expect that to be some between 25%-30%.
We expect the yield to be somewhere around 18%. It may go down by 25 basis points or go up by 25 basis.
So we have the plan to open around 500 branches now.
On an incremental basis, I would say, we will be around the 8.8 to 9 handle
We are targeting an ROA of around 3.5% to 4%
In three years, our expectation is to take that ROE to around 18%.

current_guidance.target: None in FY27; restart reviewed in FY28
current_guidance.quote: We do not want to disburse any more vehicle loans during this year.

current_guidance.target: Gold 75-80% of consolidated AUM; microfinance capped at 8-10%
current_guidance.quote: the microfinance will be contained between 8%-10%. That will be the cap on a consolidated basis we will put.

credibility.label: mixed
credibility.summary: Management beat its short-term profit calls: PAT rose from 239 to 405 to 585 over Q3 FY26 to Q1 FY27, against a guide of 'similar or slightly better'. But dates slipped (Bain approval, strategy roadmap), the plan to restart non-gold growth was reversed, and the yield, branch and ROA targets were lowered while growth and ROE targets were raised.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Q4 FY26 is 'the bottom' and Q1 FY27 will be 'similar or slightly better'.
Gold loan growth was held back by slow disbursements, with a 20-25% CAGR target.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FY26 borrowings grew 60.3% to 57,837, and operating cash flow was -20,238 (vs -467 in FY25). That points to balance-sheet growth well above 20-25%, but AUM isn't disclosed.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Profit will recover as non-gold stress fades and per-branch business grows.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: FY26 PAT 993 was down 17.5% from 1,204 in FY25. TTM PAT about 1,445 is still 34.2% below FY24's 2,197, though Q1 FY27 PAT of 585 is above Q1 FY25's 557.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: The financials should look 'green' by Q4 FY26.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Consolidated PAT was positive in every FY26 quarter (132, 217, 239, 405) and rose each quarter.

bull.point: Earnings have recovered faster than management guided.
bull.evidence: Q1 FY27 PAT 585 vs 132 in Q1 FY26 and 405 in Q4 FY26; it is now above Q1 FY25's 557. Revenue was up 34.1% YoY to 3,034.

bull.point: Growth guidance was raised, and the funding to support it is in place.
bull.evidence: Gold AUM growth guide moved from a 20-25% CAGR to 25-30% for FY27. FY26 borrowings rose 60.3% to 57,837.

bull.point: Risk is being cut in the non-gold book.
bull.evidence: No vehicle disbursements in FY27, microfinance capped at 8-10% of consolidated AUM, gold kept at 75-80% of AUM.

bear.evidence: Bain approval was guided 'in another one month' in Nov 2025 and again in Feb 2026. The strategy moved from Q4 FY26 to Q1 FY27. The Q1 FY27 non-gold growth restart turned into a vehicle lending halt.

bear.point: Return and pricing targets have been reset lower.
bear.evidence: Standalone ROA guide was 4.25-4.5% for H2 FY27 (Q3 FY26 call p13); Q1 FY27 says 3.5-4%. Yield guide fell from about 18.5% to about 18% ±25 bps.

bear.point: Annual profit is still well below earlier levels, and margins are lower.
bear.evidence: FY26 PAT 993 vs 2,197 in FY24. TTM PAT about 1,445 is 34.2% below FY24. Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin was 28.1% vs 31.9% in Q1 FY25.
